level_reason: The change is in process supervision: lifetime of the engine child, pipes, cancellation and shutdown. Targeted platform checks of the process suites are necessary. No packaged GUI campaign.

source.note: Integrated as f7ab97f3 after a rebase on 154431cb; the commits between differ only in Backlog task records, so the source content is the same as 2274e03a. Later commits on this task add only this evidence, the measurement wrapper and task records.

environment_local: Apple M1 Pro, macOS (Darwin 27.0.0), stable Rust from rust-toolchain.toml

checks.name: engine session through serve
checks.result: passed: timed searches of one game share state (a repeated search uses fewer than half the nodes); a different or shorter game starts empty (node count equal to a new process); searches without a time budget give the same node count each time and leave the kept state; malformed and incomplete input is an error

checks.name: bridge with the real engine and the failure fixture
checks.command: cargo test -p mshogi-console --test internal (three times in sequence)
checks.result: passed 9 of 9 each time: kept state between searches; cancellation and replacement of a running search stop the child and the next search starts empty; a kept child that ended normally is replaced without a failure; a kept child that fails during a request is UnexpectedExit with the diagnostic of that request; the earlier failure kinds are unchanged

checks.name: targeted process suite on three platforms
checks.command: gh workflow run rust.yml --ref claude/msh-169-engine-session -f suite=process -f platform=all (cargo test --release --locked -p mshogi-engine -p mshogi-runner -p mshogi-console --tests)
checks.result: passed: ubuntu-24.04, macos-15, windows-2022, and the routine checks

checks.name: gain of the kept table (acceptance criterion 1)
checks.result: SPRT accepted H1 at 32 pairs: +29 -6 =29, Elo +130.7 [+78.3, +189.5] at 200 ms per move; wall 186 s, CPU 1228 s
checks.limits: Self-play of one engine revision (6fef75d1) on the UCI path: kept table against a wrapper that sends ucinewgame before each position. It measures the value of the kept state, which the desktop path now has. It is not a measurement through the desktop bridge and not a rating. A first run failed with zero scored pairs because the wrapper sent ucinewgame after the position; that run was discarded and the wrapper corrected.

independent_review.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 subagent with a fresh context, read-only, on the uncommitted diff before 2274e03a
independent_review.outcome: No defect against design A-05. One defect of low to medium severity and observations.

findings.text: A kept child that crashed during a request was restarted silently and its diagnostic was lost.
findings.resolution: Corrected in 2274e03a: only a normal exit without output is replaced; a failure status is UnexpectedExit. Test added.

findings.text: The stderr buffer held text of earlier requests.
findings.resolution: Corrected in 2274e03a: cleared at each request.

findings.text: Memory: idle child keeps 64 MB; an untimed request uses a second table.

findings.resolution: Added: failure of a kept child during a request, replacement of a running search. Not added: a child that writes two lines for one request, the watchdog on a reused child, the prefix rule with a different claim policy.

independent_review.re_review: The corrections were not reviewed again by the reviewer.

not_run: Packaged desktop application journey on any platform. The desktop session crate tests passed locally; the next Level 3 checkpoint covers the packaged application.
Desktop session and Tauri host tests on Linux and Windows (the targeted suite covers engine, runner and console).
